domains.name: Marvin (this host)
domains.note: No http_interval_minutes, deliberately. ai4shops is throttled because probing it wakes a metered serverless database; there is no such cost here. And this is the check that would notice a firewall change locking the world out of 443, so throttling it would only widen the window in which that goes unseen. The monitor ignores unknown keys; this one is documentation.
